summary: Iteration 8 — Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Memory System, Knowledge Base (RAG), Admin Dashboard, and Emotion/Tone. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (admin guards 401/403/200, admin stats/users/conversations, knowledge CRUD full cycle, RAG returns Five Realms, memory extraction + delete flow, tone warm vs firm differ, /api/voice/speak with tone, agent=debugger regression). Frontend: /admin logged-out redirects to /auth, non-admin sees admin-denied, tone select visible only for signed-in users, admin sees profile-admin-link and full /admin console (stats/users/convos/kb), KB add + delete via UI works end-to-end, profile-memory-card renders with correct testids. All new features functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1050 lines — approaching split threshold (>700). Consider extracting auth/admin/paypal/court routers into modules.

_extract_memory runs as fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task on every /api/chat — for logged-in users this fires an extra LLM call per message. Consider batching or debouncing (e.g. only every Nth message) to reduce cost.

_kb_context uses simple word-count keyword scoring; short queries with <=3-char words return no results (word length filter >3). Fine for RAG demo but flag as limitation — consider stemming or embeddings for production.
TONE_PROMPTS injects mid-system-message; tone=firm/warm produce visibly different outputs (verified). Good.

admin_stats: `court_filings` counts distinct session_ids where model=='court', which is correct. `sessions` counts ALL distinct session_ids across chat_messages (includes court + image sessions). Might not be what UI implies — minor.
Admin.jsx: `if (user === false)` — relies on AuthContext setting user to literal false when unauth (vs null). Verified redirect works. Fine.
user_memories cap logic runs after each insert (count>50 then delete oldest). Correct.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@frasberg.com / LuchiiAdmin2026! (works). Fresh users registered via /api/auth/register with tester+<uuid>@frasberg.com / Test1234! — registration returns 200 and sets auth cookie; explicit login also succeeds.
seed_data_creation: Test knowledge doc 'TEST_Doc_Zorbits' created + deleted per test (self-cleaning). Test users tester+<uuid>@frasberg.com left in DB (small volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-8 features are green. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_memory_kb.py can serve as regression for admin/memory/KB/tone. Memory extraction is async background — allow up to ~30s polling GET /api/memory. Frontend selectors are all present and stable: admin-stats, admin-users-table, admin-conversations, admin-kb-list, admin-kb-add-btn, admin-kb-title/content/tags/save, admin-kb-delete-<id>, admin-denied, profile-memory-card, memory-forget-<id>, profile-admin-link, chat-tone-select. Guests correctly do not see chat-tone-select.
